in_marathi.name: Athaj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Athaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'atha' meaning 'father' and 'jaya' meaning 'joy'. This name signifies the happiness and pride a father feels towards his child.
